description: List current offers (price, shipping, delivery, stock, shop link) for one product from search_products, optionally for one pack (a pack is one pack-size label as shown on the product page; it can hold several PZNs, e.g. an original and its reimports), plus the lowest price of the last 90 days. price_check: the pack's Preis-Check, 0-10 from four bars - price now vs the last weeks, lowest recorded price, saving vs the typical offer, shops in stock; method at method_url. It describes the pack as the product page shows it, so its shop count and price can differ from this answer's offers, which leave out excluded shops and zero prices. unit_price is the normalized base price (Grundpreis) of the offer: {value, per} in EUR per 1 l, per 1 kg or per piece (per = l, kg, pcs); absent when unknown. Each offer's shipping object gives the shipping for that offer bought alone and its source (rule: the shop's checked terms; feed: the shop's product data; unknown). Each result carries a disclosure (affiliate links, price source) and, for medicines, a compliance_notice with the statutory German notice. Prices only, from German online shops; no medical advice.

pack_size.description: A pack from search_products: its identity_key when it has one, else its label. A pack is one pack-size label as shown on the product page.
